newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 4,268 to the dollar for Jan 10-12 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 4,268 to the dollar for Jan 10-12 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate weaker at 4,268 to the dollar for January 10 to 12.
This reference rate was set on Wednesday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Tuesday for January 9 is 4,138 to the dollar. It was 4,143 on Wednesday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
